## Results

| comparator | accuracy | macro-F1 | rows | invalid predictions | failures | truncated |

Invalid, unparseable and failed outputs count as wrong and stay in every denominator. `unavailable` means the metric does not exist for that row; it is never shown as 0.

## What the numbers say

On 18 validation rows, accuracy: embedding baseline (MiniLM + logistic regression): 1.000; student, prompted, untrained: 0.333; student, trained: 0.889.
The embedding baseline (MiniLM + logistic regression) scored 0.111 higher than the trained student (2 rows).
The trained student scored 0.556 higher than the student, prompted, untrained (10 rows).

No significance test was run and none is implied. These are the observed differences on this validation set; a few rows can move a score on a set this size. Changing the batch shape can also move a score through numerical differences; that is a diagnostic, not evidence either way.
